en.headline: CNBC to close Hong Kong office and drop several shows
en.dek: The business channel is shutting its Hong Kong operations as part of a programming overhaul, with coverage of the city and region to continue from other Asian bureaux.
body: CNBC is closing its Hong Kong office and has already ended several daily live programmes, a spokesman confirmed, as the network adjusts its international line-up under parent Versant Media Group.

Shows including Inside India, The China Connection and Europe Early Edition have ceased, along with specials such as CNBC Meets and Built for Billions. A small number of staff were affected by the closure.

International reporting will continue to be led from London, Abu Dhabi, Singapore and Beijing. The spokesman said the network would keep covering Hong Kong and the wider region despite the office shutdown.

zh.headline: CNBC關閉香港辦事處 停播多個直播節目
zh.dek: 財經頻道確認關閉香港辦公室並調整節目，香港及地區報道將繼續由其他亞洲分社負責。
body: CNBC確認關閉香港辦事處，並已停播多個每日直播節目，作為母公司Versant Media Group旗下國際節目調整的一部分。
包括《Inside India》、《The China Connection》及《Europe Early Edition》等節目已經停播，專題節目《CNBC Meets》及《Built for Billions》亦會取消。關閉行動影響少數員工。
國際新聞報道將繼續由倫敦、阿布扎比、新加坡及北京主導。發言人表示，即使關閉香港辦公室，頻道仍會繼續報道香港及更廣泛地區的消息。
